facts.activity_file: draining, venting and warming through steam systems

assets.label: package boilers and deaerator
assets.service: process steam generation and feedwater deaeration

control_failures.control_label: insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces

facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of D-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces on D-8210 and PSV-8210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating hot and steam systems, specifically draining, venting and warming through steam systems. D-8210 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 1 March 2011 a hazard report was recorded on D-8210 and PSV-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during a statutory inspection; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
